response.why: I'm ahead on board (5/5 Eddymurk Crab in play, a second one castable for near-free) and life (18 vs 11 after Burst Lightning resolves), with removal and card draw still in hand. Passing/holding while Burst Lightning resolves keeps maximum flexibility and mana open for whatever they do; deploying the second Eddymurk Crab proactively is strong when it lands untapped and available to block, but leaves me tapped-out lines slightly worse defensively. Lines where they get a big mana Hearth Elemental up or where my Torch the Tower fizzles for lack of a real kill (2 damage doesn't kill a 5/5) score lower; lines where I keep two untapped 5/5s or push more damage while they're empty-boarded score higher.
response.plan: Let Burst Lightning resolve, then continue the plan: attack with the first Eddymurk Crab, deploy the second Eddymurk Crab (cheap off graveyard count) preferably at a point where it stays untapped for blocking, and hold Torch the Tower/Opt/Glacial Dragonhunt as follow-up interaction and gas for their turn.

response.why: Opponent is at 6 life (dropping to 4 in many lines) with only one summoning-sick Eddymurk Crab as a blocker, while I have two ready-to-attack 5/5 Crabs plus card draw and burn in hand - a dominant, near-lethal position. Lines where I find and use Burst Lightning to push extra damage or where the opponent taps their own blocker for Harmonize/cost reduction score highest; lines where my card gets Spell Snare'd or the opponent lands a second big creature with lots of open mana are a bit more cautious, though I remain clearly favored throughout since a single unblocked Crab attack already puts them at 1 life or less.
response.plan: Look for a way to draw into or already hold enough burn/removal to clear the opposing Crab blocker before combat, then attack with both Eddymurk Crabs for lethal (opponent at 6, only one blocker); if the blocker can't be cleared, attack anyway - one Crab trades or gets blocked while the other connects for 5, bringing them to 1 and setting up a guaranteed kill next turn.
